outcome.technical: ONE RULE, ONE HOME. _manifest_phases.slot_takes(path, takes_sources) decides each declared path: path_kind(path) suite -> always; source -> only when takes_sources; document/workflow/config/other -> never (path_kind: suite by is_suite_path first; workflow by .github/workflows, .circleci, .buildkite dirs or root CI files; document by extension; config by extension, a dotfile, or a config/conf word inside the name, so jest.config.js and .eslintrc.js are configs; source by a module-language extension). takes_sources is _gate_derive.slot_takes_sources(shape, source, build, keep): one reading for a recorded template and a sibling alike, the word directly in front of the slot ({paths}, or the sibling's first non-program path) is --findRelatedTests (any runner) or `related` after vitest (RELATED_SLOT_WORDS); an option's argument (--config x, -c x) and what the slot holds are never evidence. The refusal reads back by position: _gate_derive.slot_paths(entry, ...) gives the paths a written entry hands its slot (none for a build key or an always entry; for a template-filled entry the paths between the template's words before and after {paths}; else every path but a non-suite program) and untaken_slot_paths names each declared path there that slot_takes refuses, whatever the spelling. Callers: audit-task._ordinary_task_gate files arm (and so scope's _rederive_gate) and the gate-only arm (slot_takes(p, False)), _files_gate_refusal (add and batch add). Removed: audit-task._slot_paths, _spelling_reach, _manifest_phases.files_gate_non_suite_paths (its only callers were audit-task and bx11). Re-point keeps the spelling's own paths by position: repointed/repointed_by_runner take keep= (the plan's always entries, carried whole; audit-task._point passes them via _always_entries) and keep a non-suite program where it stands (_program_index; _manifest_phases.command_slots is the same reading; a suite run as the program stays the slot).
